memories.content: The account manager is preparing for a scheduled retention call with Fenwick & Sloane. They know Fenwick & Sloane has expressed intent to cancel their subscription. The account manager has a standard retention script and some flexibility to offer discounts or pauses. They want to persuade the retailer to pause rather than cancel.

A scheduled retention call is set to occur between Brightline Software's account manager and a representative from Fenwick & Sloane during the week of 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-11. The call is the primary channel for discussing the subscription status. Fenwick & Sloane has indicated they want to cancel, but Brightline hopes to offer a pause as an alternative.
